applicable_conditions: multiple candidates had aircraft destroyed before release
candidate_00 changed launch delay and altitude for J15_1; candidate_01 changed timing and range
counter_conditions: Missing weapon release data for many sorties
Changes in other strategy fields simultaneously
hypothesis: Aircraft early loss before weapon release may be associated with changes in launch delay and ingress altitude, but missing scoring evidence prevents attribution of these changes to the observed outcome.

recommended_pattern.summary: Conduct a factorial experiment varying one factor at a time (launch delay, ingress altitude, attack range) while recording detailed weapon release events and scoring evidence, to determine which factor affects survival-to-release.
